agent_note: First-person present-tense narration. Quote set is heavily dialogue-selected (19 of 25) — typical of Goodreads romantasy pages — leaving only 3 usable event-narration quotes, all present. The strongest evidence is not the event count but the tags and beats attached to the dialogue quotes, which are uniformly present tense across 12 separate quotes ("I enunciate", "He cups", "Rhi snorts", "Xaden says", "He cradles", "I whisper", "He fucking smirks", "He lifts his head", "Ridoc says/asks", "Xaden slides", "Aaric asks", "I tell Tairn") with zero past-tense tags. Mark survival is inconsistent: several quotes lost their opening quotation mark, so unmarked quotes were judged on vocatives and second-person address rather than punctuation; the four unmarked quotes with an addressee went to dialogue, the two without went to event. Two abstentions (q09648, q09661) are the only past-tense candidates in the set and both lack marks — under 5 event quotes, so this book is INSUFFICIENT by the thresholds and may need a deeper page fetch.
